summary: Selecting a value or a numeric range by dragging a thumb, with localized formatting.
whenToUse: Approximate values within a known range (volume, max price).
whenNotToUse: Precise values to type in: use NumberInput.
Very wide ranges where one pixel equals many units.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label, linked to all thumbs.

props.name: onChangeEnd
props.description: Called on release: useful for saving or filtering.

props.name: formatOptions
props.description: Value formatting (currency, unit, percent) according to the locale.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Shows the formatted value next to the label.

props.name: showBounds
props.description: Shows the minimum and maximum below the track.

props.name: name / startName / endName
props.description: Names of the fields submitted with the form.

props.name: thumbLabels
props.description: Accessible names of the two thumbs (localized defaults “Minimum”/“Maximum”).

inherits: Props of the react-aria-components Slider (orientation, isDisabled, aria-*).

keyboard.action: Changes the value by one step.

accessibility: Each thumb is a hidden <input type="range">: it works with screen readers and keyboards.
The announced value uses the same Intl formatting shown on screen.
In RTL the direction is reversed automatically.
responsive: The track takes the full available width; thumbs have a 24 px touch area.
customization: className and style on the container; colors derive from color.action.primary and color.border.*.
commonMistakes: Using onChange for expensive requests: use onChangeEnd.
Hiding the value without a text alternative where precision matters.
